In April 2026 I gave a talk at PyData London on survival analysis and causal inference — three ways to say "because" using hazard models. The slides can be found [here](https://nathanielf.github.io/talks/pydata_london_2026/dynamic_path_analysis.html#/title-slide).

The recording of the talk is available on YouTube.
